items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: A guy named Johnny Otis. Johnny Otis was playing the Club Alabam

ctx.x: So she and Lennie took a little tour, and she said, 'I want you to be available when I come back.' So, she was supposed to have been gone about three months. Well, she was gone about six. Well, I begin to get restless, so I used to hang around down on Central Avenue at a place called the Club Alabam, with a great band, swingin' band down there, and you must have known this guy. A guy named Johnny Otis.
Oh yeah. He's still doing a thing today.
